title: Rav Acha bar Bivi Mar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.8a.19), where he said to Ravina: “Thus we say in Rava’s name.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Rav Acha bar Bivi Mar speaking to Ravina and citing Rava. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=312&lang=en) records the same exchange with a shorter name.
